scope: Pre-registered evaluation design; no unseen-data results or performance claims.
primary_question: Does evidence-aware context gating improve rule precision and actionable defect detection at reported coverage over data-only and prompt-only baselines?
source_leakage_policy: Freeze source/reference catalogue and model prompts before independent test acquisition.
Do not include reference-rule equations in the LLM metadata input bundle (only independently allowed attribute descriptions).
Use the same metadata fields, model budgets and temperature/reasoning settings for each model comparison.
Do not tune tolerances, rounding, thresholds, or policies using a purported held-out test set.
Retain raw LLM outputs, prompt hashes, review decisions, reference-source links and sampling seeds.
Any change after unblinding must increment protocol version and label affected results exploratory.

reference_adjudication.disagreement_resolution: adjudicator checks official source and full applicability conditions; consensus and raw votes retained
reference_adjudication.final_gold_requires: Two independent reviews with conflict resolution and locked reference snapshot. Provisional entries cannot enter gold-rule precision denominator.

healthcare.development: NHANES 2017-2018 GLU_J: all 3036 rows previously inspected; not a blind test.
healthcare.confirmatory: Choose an untouched non-overlapping NHANES cycle such as 2015-2016 GLU_I; freeze conversion/precision interpretation before inspecting values; document method changes.

finance.development: Ten SEC companyfacts and the examined 2024-2025 contexts are exploratory; not untouched confirmation.
finance.confirmatory: Select unseen CIKs before inspecting values. Match filing accession, balance date, taxonomy/tag, currency, unit and consolidation scope; avoid duplicate fact-frames.

manufacturing.development: AI4I 2020 (10,000 synthetic observations) has already been inspected.
manufacturing.confirmatory: If only AI4I is available, report internal held-out analysis without claiming new external data; external generalisation needs a separately sourced manufacturing dataset.

cybersecurity.development: Previously sampled CIC-IDS2017 flow files have been inspected.
cybersecurity.confirmatory: Partition by capture/day/source group when available; check no shared flows across splits; if group provenance absent, mark confirmation limited.

methods_to_compare: data-only range/association heuristic with matched opportunity budget
LLM proposal with B4 structural compilation only (ablation)

outcomes.rule_precision: # independently adjudicated correct proposed rules / # proposed rules assigned a correctness judgement; unresolved/abstained proposals are separately reported, not silently dropped.
outcomes.proposal_coverage: # valid proposals produced / # predeclared discovery opportunities; explicitly report proposals without available reference status.
outcomes.verifier_coverage: (satisfied + violated) / (satisfied + violated + abstained) among applicable rows; condition-false rows are not_applicable and excluded from denominator.
outcomes.abstention_rate: abstained / eligible rows; report by evidence, missing context, missing values and unresolved parameter.
outcomes.injected_defect_precision: TP / (TP + FP) for predefined injected defect labels; undefined if denominator zero.
outcomes.injected_defect_recall: TP / (TP + FN) among injected defects eligible for evaluation; report unevaluable injections separately.
outcomes.false_positive_rate_clean: FP / (FP + TN) on independently reviewed clean eligible rows; undefined if denominator zero.
outcomes.runtime: wall-clock median and p95 per method over repeated fixed-hardware runs; record dataset size and platform.
outcomes.cost: API input/output token counts and nominal dollar costs separated from local compute and review time.

injection_controls: Inject only errors guaranteed to violate a qualified rule within its applicability scope.
Use deterministic mutation seeds, mutation families, sample identifiers and positive/negative controls.
Do not equate injected-error recall with real natural-defect precision.
Keep no-op/correct-preserving mutations and context-mismatch controls.
caveat: Protocol is pinned; reference catalogue will be expanded under version control. No result is currently a final, independently reviewed four-domain gold benchmark.
